What we can promise is the part we control: sizing you can check before you order, tracking on every parcel, and a person answering your email rather than a script.

settings.heading: Direct from our suppliers.
settings.text:
We work directly with the manufacturers who make our pieces and ship from their facilities, which keeps the usual retail markup out of the price.

It also means an order with several items can arrive in more than one parcel, each with its own tracking. Nothing extra to pay — just more than one delivery.
